intro: Where this benchmark's tasks come from, every change to them as a version, how personal data in imported rows is handled, and who may read the task content.

policy.title: Personal data
policy.description: Every import and every row sent through the API is scanned for emails, phone numbers, card numbers, national ids, bank accounts and names before it becomes a task.
policy.loadError: Could not load the data policy

access.title: Who may read the tasks
access.description: Restricted: only organization admins, owners and the people listed see task inputs and answers. Everyone still sees scores.
access.restricted: Admins, owners and the people listed
access.adminOnly: Only an organization admin or owner changes who may read the tasks.
access.denied: This benchmark's task content is restricted. Ask an organization admin for access.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Each change to the tasks made from rows, newest first. An evaluation records the version it ran on.
versions.empty: No versions yet. Add tasks from rows, an import or the API.

api.title: Manage from code
api.description: The same rows, versions and policy through API v1 or the Python and TypeScript clients.

import.title: Import from another platform
import.description: Bring a dataset or recent traces from LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust or Datadog, with the keys you keep in Secrets. Always previewed first.
import.kindDataset: A dataset, as tasks of this benchmark
import.kindTraces: Recent traces, as tasks of this benchmark
import.truncated: More records exist; only the first ones were read.
